description: This file defines a WaterTile class for a Unity project, managing water rendering components like reflections and water base properties, and handling rendering updates.

classes.name: WaterTile
classes.description: Manages water surface components and rendering behavior, including reflection and water base updates.

methods.name: Start
methods.description: Initializes the components by acquiring references to reflection and water base objects.

methods.name: AcquireComponents
methods.description: Attempts to assign the reflection and waterBase components from the current object or its parent.

methods.name: Update
methods.description: Re-acquires component references during edit mode to reflect any changes.

methods.name: OnWillRenderObject
methods.description: Informs reflection and water base objects that the water tile is about to be rendered.
